completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).
Next: reporter runs the four manual document-switch scenarios on Windows and records the Event Viewer code to confirm the dominant defect path. — NOTE: low evidence density: no path:line evidence tokens and no verification gate rows — add file:line pointers (e.g. extensions/goal-recovery.ts:847) or a gateRows inventory so the terminal render is verifiable

completionRecap.summary:

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).
Next: reporter runs the four manual document-switch scenarios on Windows and records the Event Viewer code to confirm the dominant defect path. — NOTE: low evidence density: no path:line evidence tokens and no verification gate rows — add file:line pointers (e.g. extensions/goal-recovery.ts:847) or a gateRows inventory so the terminal render is verifiable

completionRecap.summary:

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).
Next: reporter runs the four manual document-switch scenarios on Windows and records the Event Viewer code to confirm the dominant defect path. — NOTE: low evidence density: no path:line evidence tokens and no verification gate rows — add file:line pointers (e.g. extensions/goal-recovery.ts:847) or a gateRows inventory so the terminal render is verifiable

completionRecap.summary:

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.

completionRecap.summary:
Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Fixed by adding `m_runningGeneration = m_generation` at the top of `calculate()` (mirrors OrbitalExtension::startCalculation). A second, unflagged regression was also found and fixed: the N.1/N.2 rewrite had dropped `m_molecule = molecule;` from `setMolecule`, so `m_molecule` was always null and `loadBasis()`/`calculate()` would null-deref; restored it. Added a white-box regression test `surfaceextensionTest` that drives the real `calculate()` path and asserts the captured generation equals the current one (proves the guard passes); it fails without the fix and passes with it.
Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.
Tests: `ctest` 13/13 pass (0 failed); `surfaceextensionTest` fails-without-fix / passes-with-fix (both run); `avogadro-app` + `surfaceextensiontest` build clean; openbabel_ext .so stable, 0 rebuild refs in plan.
Unresolved: GUI reproduction scenarios (b) precalc-running and (d) open-shell second, and the reporter's Windows Event Viewer exception code (OpenSpec task 16), still require the reporter's Windows/GUI environment — no open-shell ORCA file exists in the repo; design N.6a records these explicitly (not silent).

Outcome: Resolved the auditor's disapproval of change "fix-second-document-open-crash". The blocking defect was a half-implemented N.1 stale-callback guard in SurfaceExtension: `m_runningGeneration` was only ever set to 0 (ctor + setMolecule) and never captured at calculation launch, so after the first `setMolecule` bumped `m_generation` to >=1 the guard `m_runningGeneration != m_generation` was true forever and every legitimate `calculateDone()` early-returned — no surface could ever render. Changed: libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.cpp (capture + m_molecule restore), libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp (new), libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (test target, -fno-access-control + OpenQube/Qt6-Concurrent/OpenBabel links). Commit 87d8763a6.
Evidence: commit 87d8763a6; ctest 13/13 passing (87s); surfaceextensionTest verified to fail at the capture assertion when the fix is reverted and pass when restored; auditor's own falsification evidence quoted in audit-jobs.

OpenSpec is authoritative for scope, requirements, workflow, artifacts, and task state.
Current schema: spec-driven.
Starting task progress: 0/8.

The GLLA task list is preloaded deterministically from the OpenSpec task list at goal creation.
It is a status mirror, not an independent planning source. Do not call propose_task_list merely to recreate the initial OpenSpec task breakdown.

Initial task mapping:
- GLLA 1 <- OpenSpec 1: [ ] 1.1 In `libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.h`, move exactly these six declarations from the `private:` block into a new `protected:` block placed before it (preserve original relative order, types, and trailing comments): `unsigned long m_generation;`, `unsigned long m_runningGeneration;`, `SurfaceDialog *m_surfaceDialog;`, `Molecule *m_molecule;`, `VdWSurface *m_VdWsurface;`, `bool loadBasis();`. Leave `m_glwidget`, `m_cubes`, `m_moCubes`, `m_calculationPhase`, `m_actions`, `m_basis`, `m_loadedFileName`, `m_progress`, `m_mesh1/2`, `m_meshGen1/2`, `m_cube`, `m_qube`, `m_cubeColor` and all other helpers `private`. Verify with: `grep -n "protected:" libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/surfaceextension.h` shows one new section; `git diff` shows access-specifier lines only (no moved statements, no layout-affecting reorder of member declarations beyond their new section placement).
- GLLA 2 <- OpenSpec 2: [ ] 1.2 In `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt`, delete the line `target_compile_options(surfaceextensiontest PRIVATE -fno-access-control)`.
- GLLA 3 <- OpenSpec 3: [ ] 2.1 Rewrite the header comment in `libavogadro/tests/surfaceextensiontest.cpp` (the "NB: this environment's g++-13 enforces Java/C#-style access control..." paragraph): replace with an accurate note that this is a white-box regression test whose subclass accesses `protected` internals (the N.1 generation guard members) per standard C++, with no access-suppression flags.
- GLLA 4 <- OpenSpec 4: [ ] 2.2 Delete the false comment block in `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` that introduced the flag (the "This environment's g++-13 enforces Java/C#-style access semantics..." lines). Leave no stale reference to `-fno-access-control` anywhere in the repo: `grep -rn "fno-access-control\|Java/C#" libavogadro/ openspec/specs/ || true` must return nothing (archived change dirs are history — do not edit them).
- GLLA 5 <- OpenSpec 5: [ ] 3.1 Clean-configure and build the affected targets: `cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build --target surfaceextensiontest avogadro-app --parallel 8` — both must compile with zero access errors and zero new warnings in the touched files. **Always cap jobs at 8** (`-j8` / `--parallel 8`, never bare `--parallel` or `-j$(nproc)`): this machine OOMs when the build uses all cores.
- GLLA 6 <- OpenSpec 6: [ ] 3.2 Run the regression test and the full suite: `ctest --test-dir build -R surfaceextensionTest --output-on-failure` (must pass) and `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` (13/13, must stay green). Confirm the test still proves the fix: temporarily comment out `m_runningGeneration = m_generation;` in `surfaceextension.cpp` `calculate()`, rebuild, and confirm `surfaceextensionTest` FAILS at the capture assertion; restore and confirm it passes again.
- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [ ] 4.1 Commit (message should note the corrected root cause: the access was ill-formed standard C++; GCC was right; `-fno-access-control` masked it) and push to `master`.
- GLLA 8 <- OpenSpec 8: [ ] 4.2 Watch CI to completion: `build-installer (tests)` (run started by the push) must go green — this is the acceptance gate for this change; Linux `ci.yml` and `build-installer (installer)` must remain green. If the Windows test leg builds but the test fails at runtime, diagnose before weakening anything (first suspect: GUI/session environment; remedy is `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen` for the test process, never assertion changes).

Use the installed OpenSpec apply workflow/skill as the implementation procedure.

At the start of work, after every context compaction, after every resume, and whenever task state is uncertain:

1. Run:
   openspec status --change "fix-windows-ci-surface-test" --json

2. Run:
   openspec instructions apply --change "fix-windows-ci-surface-test" --json

3. Treat the returned OpenSpec state, instruction, tasks, context, operationGuidance, and contextFiles as authoritative.

4. Read all contextFiles relevant to the remaining work before modifying code.

Resume from the first genuinely incomplete task. Do not redo completed work unnecessarily.

Implement every remaining required task.

GLLA task-list synchronization is a hard, per-task requirement, using GLLA's own task tools (not prose):

- GLLA task id N mirrors exactly one OpenSpec task; its title prefix "[OpenSpec <task-id>]" names that OpenSpec task.
- When you START a mirrored OpenSpec task, call update_task_status with that GLLA id and status "in_progress".
- In the SAME turn where you legitimately flip an OpenSpec checkbox to "- [x]" (or otherwise complete that OpenSpec task), call complete_task with the corresponding GLLA id. One OpenSpec checkbox flip = one complete_task call. Never batch all syncs to the end of the session.
- When several mirrored tasks genuinely finish in one turn, one update_task_batch call is also acceptable.
- GLLA's pending-task gate REFUSES complete_goal while any mirrored GLLA task is still open — a stale mirror blocks goal completion even when OpenSpec itself is finished.
- Never mark either side complete merely because work was attempted.
- The bridge extension also mirrors OpenSpec completions into the GLLA list at turn boundaries as a safety net, but do not rely on it; keep the mirror correct yourself.

If the authoritative OpenSpec task set itself changes after attachment, do not silently ignore the difference or invent an independent plan. Reconcile against a fresh OpenSpec apply response before completion.

Run relevant builds, focused tests, integration tests, and regression checks as work progresses. Fix failures caused by this change rather than bypassing them.

Do not weaken, delete, rewrite, reinterpret, or silently defer OpenSpec requirements merely to make implementation easier.

Do not switch to a different OpenSpec change.

If OpenSpec reports state="blocked", resolve the missing required planning artifact through the OpenSpec workflow before continuing implementation. Do not invent missing requirements merely to get past the block.

If OpenSpec reports state="all_done", do not immediately declare success. Perform the final verification below first.

Before claiming completion, independently re-read:

- the current OpenSpec status;
- the current OpenSpec apply instructions;
- all relevant OpenSpec artifacts;
- the repository diff and working-tree state;
- the actual build/test/regression outputs.
